results.name: Beyond the Brave Booster Box [1st Edition]
results.cleanName: Beyond the Brave Booster Box 1st Edition

extendedData.name: Description
extendedData.value:
Step into the duel with Beyond the Brave, a core booster set that puts fan-favorite icon Joey Wheeler right on the cover. This expansion introduces exciting new cards centered around Dark Time Wizard and the mighty Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed. Whether you are hunting for high-end collector rarities or fresh support for classic archetypes like Destiny HERO, this set gives you everything you need to risk it all.
Beyond the Brave Booster Box contains twenty-four, 9 card booster packs.

extendedData.name: Description
extendedData.value: This card can be used as any Token.

extendedData.name: Description
extendedData.value:
Cannot declare an attack unless a monster was Tributed this turn. During the Main Phase, if this card is on the field (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other monster from your hand or field, then activate 1 of these effects;
• Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your hand or Deck, except "Swiftwind Panther Warrior".
• Send 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck to the GY.
You can only use this effect of "Swiftwind Panther Warrior" once per turn.
